title: selaginella tenera
intro: Selaginella tenera, commonly known as Peacock Spikemoss, is a type of evergreen, rhizomatous plant that belongs to the family Selaginellaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory function, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Selaginella tenera are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may modulate immune responses and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents in Selaginella tenera also include alkaloids and glycosides, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
